Create one polished static factual editorial raster illustration, 1200x630 landscape. White background, cobalt with subdued olive accents, crisp textbook linework and meaningful exposed mechanism detail. No photographs, people, humanoids, logos, dashboards, cards, decorative gears, shields, invented UI controls, fake writing, numerical charts, checkmarks or stray symbols. This is a conceptual editorial illustration, not a measured engineering drawing.
Visual thesis: Full-trajectory expert judgment supplies rubric reasons used to calibrate evaluators and build reusable golden examples for future evaluations.
Composition: Left complete chronological trajectory; central judgment and judge comparison; right split reuse branches meeting a next-evaluation return lane; detached caveat.

Central evidence junction includes rubric dimensions shown as unequal categorical shapes with no score digits, a reason annotation area with only its exact label, paired human and automated judgments abstractly represented without avatars, and a disagreement comparison junction. Right has an evaluator revision layer, curated-example stack and next evaluation fixture with two separately sourced inputs. At least twelve meaningful parts. Show no automatic model training, guaranteed uplift, checkmarks or invented rubric words. Golden examples derive from reviewed human labels, not directly from automated judge output. No path bypasses full-trajectory judgment.
Only visible text, each exactly once: ["Full trajectory","Expert criteria reused","Rubric judgment","Reason recorded","Compare judge","Revise evaluator","Golden examples","Next evaluation","Workflow, not measured uplift"]. All other surfaces are blank or depict meaningful shapes, never imitation writing. Use two or three designated priority labels at least36px at final resolution and every secondary label at least28px, dark high-contrast type. Allow multiline wrapping inside supplied boxes without changing words. Maintain40px safe margins. Caveat is a detached bottom note; no arrow touches it.
Draw only these directional relationships: Full trajectory -> Rubric judgment; Rubric judgment -> Reason recorded; Reason recorded -> Compare judge; Compare judge -> Revise evaluator; Rubric judgment -> Golden examples; Revise evaluator -> Next evaluation; Golden examples -> Next evaluation. Other comparison or association guides, if described, are nondirectional. Route connectors around text rather than through labels, attach to the corresponding objects beside those labels, and preserve each endpoint region. Geometry coordinates are editorial layout guidance, never physical measurements.
